summary: CLAIM C-0001: No conclusive explanation exists for how the Great Pyramid's blocks were lifted to height; the exact lifting/ramp method is genuinely unknown and contested.
content: The exact method by which blocks were raised to the upper levels of the Great Pyramid is not established. Multiple peer-reviewed and academic sources state no conclusive explanation has been proposed (EV-0002, EV-0005, Muller-Romer 2008) and that no documents from Khufu's time explain the technique (EV-0008). The consensus is only that ramps (supplemented by levering) are the most tenable family of methods, not that any specific ramp design is proven (EV-0001).
